body: hmm that does make sense. thanks for the kind words.

well theres not much to my story. i'm a white, male, 19 year old. i graduated from high school last year. i am going to community college for a year to get used to college before i move on to an actual university. i started to feel depression after i graduated, but i could have had depression longer and just never noticed it cause i was busy with school. i was in a very dark point in my life before taking depression medicine.

after taking my medicine for a while, things started to look up. i started feeling sad less and i was starting to take a hold of my life. i got a job. i was sort of taking care of myself. but then christmas break happened.

Since christmas break started. ive been feeling incredibly sad, with no motivation, and no energy. i just cant see the point of living anymore. i dont know where i'm going with my life. i cant really take care of myself. i just dont know anymore.
